data.description:
## Incident Overview
**What**: outbound_differ._EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = ('dso-id-', 'imported:') uses HYPHEN suffix 'dso-id-' but applier.py:637 writes the binding label as f'dso-id:{local_id}' with COLON. The prefix never matches, so the differ does NOT exclude the bridge-internal label from comparison. The differ then sees the label on Jira but not in local tags → emits a label-remove mutation for dso-id:<UUID>. The outbound audit guard (_audit_dso_id_label_writes for outbound_update path) blocks the unauthorized dso-id label write, aborting the entire outbound update mutation. Effect: NO outbound updates reach Jira for ANY bound ticket — labels, scalar fields, anything.

**Severity**: HIGH (every outbound update on a bound ticket blocked; entire outbound update channel silently broken).

## Reproduction
/tmp/labels-probe.sh T1 outbound add — local tag added, outbound pass runs, Jira does NOT receive the new label. (And the wider e2e probe matrix's Outbound UPDATE failures across all fields are likely the same root cause.)

## Suspected Fix
Change outbound_differ._EXCLUDED_PREFIXES tuple entry from 'dso-id-' to 'dso-id:'. Verify the applier and any other writers use the colon form consistently. Add a test that constructs a bound ticket with the dso-id:UUID label on Jira side and asserts no remove-label mutation is emitted by the differ.

## Discovered During
Investigation of bug 57b0-acfd-7cb1-4a3c (PR #453). Sub-agent traced the outbound symptom to this prefix mismatch while implementing the inbound labels fix.
